description: IRVE statique (organisation R-MOB Béziers) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by R-MOB Béziers. This dataset meets the specifications of the "static EVIR" schema available on schema.data.gouv.fr Charging network of the city of Béziers.\ The project provides for the deployment of approximately 70 charging points, including 20 rapids in the commune of Béziers. Coverage: R-MOB Béziers. The portal shows the English title as "Static IRVE (R-MOB Béziers organization)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is R-MOB Béziers. Its keywords include irve, bornes-de-recharge-electrique. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-02-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
